pages.title: Artisan Legacy
pages.text: $(bold)Max Level:$(r) I$(br2)$(bold)Applicable:$(r) Pickaxes, Axes, Shovels$(br2)$(bold)Effect:$(r) The tool remembers block types you mine and gets faster on repeated use, with a chance for bonus drops.$(br2)$(bold)Conflicts:$(r) Unbreaking, Durability Boost, Made in China$(br2)$(bold)Obtainment:$(r) Treasure-only: structure chests and villager trades.
